cases.name: Stefanie Kelly Stroh
cases.caseStatus: CASE NEVER TRIED; NO BODY CASE
cases.narrative: Sells claimed he picked her up when she was hitchhiking, and they took LSD together, then he strangled her in Lovelock, covered her body in concrete, and dumped it in a hot spring. Her body was never found. She was last seen at the Four Way Café and Truck Stop in Wells, NV.
